== Template code ==

<nowiki>
<div style="{{#if:{{{before|}}}|page-break-before:{{{before}}};| }}{{#if:{{{after|}}}|page-break-after:{{{after}}};| }}{{#if:{{{inside|}}}|page-break-inside:{{{inside}}};| }}">
</nowiki>

== Template usage ==

This template allows to generate page breaks for printing as described in http://www.w3.org/TR/REC-CSS2/page.html#page-breaks<br>
The template requires a closing &lt;/div&gt; or <nowiki>{{</nowiki>[[Template:Page-break/end|Page-break/end]]<nowiki>}}</nowiki> (which is the same but results in a cleaner syntax)


: '''Warning''': Apparently not all browsers or renderers implement all page break features or implement them correctly.


The template has three parameters: before, after and inside.<br>
The '''before''' and '''after''' parameters accept the values "'''auto | always | avoid | left | right | inherit'''".<br>
The '''inside''' parameter accepts only the values "'''avoid | auto | inherit'''"
[[Category:Print templates|{{PAGENAME}}]]
[[fr:Modèle:Nouvelle page imprimée]]
</noinclude>
